items.title: Worktree-mapped execution runs cannot bind: plan identity and approved-byte read use the wrong path
items.reason: render/invoke/bind pass the worktree effectivePlanPath as canonical identity, and planPathsIdentifySamePlan(canonical, worktree) is false, so there are zero candidates and explicit bind is refused. The record path reads bytes from the control-plane checkout, and showPlanAtCommit falls back to git show <c>:/abs/path, which returns null (IMPLEMENTATION_APPROVED_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE). Both verified against run_bf10663c0a8a. Fix: use run.plan_path for identity, effectivePlanPath for current bytes, and a controlPlaneRoot-relative repo path for approved bytes (relativePathUnder); add a worktree-mapped integration test.

items.title: Drift policy rejects workflow-owned post-approval plan edits (status header, Phase 0 note); this plan cannot bind its own run
items.reason: The approved commit is the reviewer head (2c23519). The later mark-reviewed Status edit (22a8dee) and the Phase 0 verification paragraph the plan requires (abaa379) are non-checkbox drift; detectPlanDrift returns drifted:true for this repo, so binding fails even in advisory mode. Choose a policy: anchor to the source run final commit, normalize workflow-owned spans, move notes to run records, or add an interim human amendment path.

items.title: normalizeCheckboxState rewrites every [x]/[ ] in the document, not only task-list markers
items.reason: Edits such as arr[x] vs arr[ ] in code or prose are hidden from drift detection. Anchor the regex to list-item checkbox markers and add a unit case.

items.title: No tests for template render / invoke implementation admission gating
items.reason: The template.handler and invoke.handler gating, including the RecordContextError IMPLEMENTATION_APPROVAL_REQUIRED fallback and -continued template selection, is untested; only the record path and bind are covered. Mirror the existing plan-review render/invoke parity tests.

items.title: Integration test claims source removal/rebuild but never rebuilds the index
items.reason: The test deletes the source run dir but runs no records rebuild, and records/index-rebuild.ts (listed in Phase 1 Files) is unchanged. Add a rebuild step or correct the checklist wording.

items.title: Malformed text-amendment lineage still authorizes the text-only exemption
items.reason: implementation.ts:818-855 resolves spans against approved bytes and sets spansAuthorized=true when detectPlanDrift reports chainValid=false; probe gives exemptionAuthorized=true and route author_revision. Plan: an unverified chain never authorizes drift. When amendments exist and the chain is invalid, skip span authorization and emit an error-severity PLAN_IMPACT_NOT_AUTHORIZED diagnostic; add malformed-chain and valid-chain-anchor tests.

items.title: Plan-contract verdicts pass unchecked in bound implementation phases
items.reason: protocol.handler.ts runs contextual validation only when verdictUsesImplementationContract is true, and implementation.ts:705 returns valid/standalone for non-plan phases without an implementation contract. A verdict with baselineAssessment/creditAssessments/plan scopeClass in an enforced bound phase is accepted, so PLAN_CONTRACT_IN_IMPLEMENTATION_PHASE is unreachable. Also validate when verdictUsesPlanContract in a non-plan phase, reject before the early return when a binding exists (keep v1/off acceptance), and add tests.

items.title: Standalone protocol validate rejects implementation verdicts without --phase
items.reason: 5x protocol validate reviewer --input v.json with a valid implementation_defect item returns UNKNOWN_PHASE. Plan: standalone validate stays usable and checks only the structural union. With no --run and no phase, return structural acceptance (domain standalone, info IMPLEMENTATION_CONTEXT_MISSING); keep UNKNOWN_PHASE for run-aware calls. Add a CLI test.

items.title: Add handler-level tests for binding mode, compatibility, missing context, PHASE_MISMATCH and RecordContextError paths
items.reason: protocol-validate.test.ts covers only plan-phase rejection and unknown work items. The binding-pinned mode, compatibility v1 path, advisory/enforced missing binding, phase mismatch and record/non-record RecordContextError branches in protocol.handler.ts are untested, and Phase 4 depends on them.
